convert_transfo_xl_checkpoint: convert a Transformer XL TensorFlow checkpoint to a PyTorch model with config and weights
convert_transfo_xl_dataset: convert a pre-processed Transformer XL corpus pickle into PyTorch vocabulary and dataset files
build_transfo_xl_model: build a PyTorch TransfoXLLMHeadModel from a JSON configuration file
load_tf_weights: load TensorFlow weights into a PyTorch TransfoXLLMHeadModel from a checkpoint path
run_convert_cli: run the Transformer XL checkpoint conversion CLI with argparse arguments
